entities.name: Franciszek Dachtera
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Franciszek Dachtera was a Polish and Roman Catholic priest. He was imprisoned in the Nazi concentration camps at Buchenwald and Dachau, where he died after being tortured in medical experiments. He is one of the 108 Martyrs of World War II.
